[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Commissions
 Section: O26R21::To whom commission may be issued.
]


A commission under rule 19 may be issued to any Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the witness resides, or, where 3*** the witness resides within the
local limits of 1[the ordinary original civil jurisdiction of the High Court], to any person whom the Court thinks fit to execute the commission.

metadata.section_title: To whom commission may be issued.
